Legal

Privacy policy

Last updated: 2 November 2026

1. Who we are

Road2Resolve Ltd (a private limited company registered in England and Wales), trading as Road2Resolve Digital (“we”, “us”), is the controller of your personal data. Company no. 13427621, registered office Xeinadin Warrington Building C - Concentric, Warrington Road, Warrington, Cheshire, WA3 6WX, United Kingdom. ICO registration no. [ICO REGISTRATION NUMBER: not found on the ICO public register yet]. Contact: info@road2resolve.digital.

2. What we collect

  • Details you send us through our form or by email: name, business name, email address, website or Google profile link, country and your message.
  • Business contact details that are publicly available (for example on a business website or Google profile), which we use to contact businesses about our services.
  • For clients: billing details, access to your Google Business Profile, and the customer contact details you choose to share with us for review requests.
  • Basic technical data held by our hosting provider (such as IP address in server logs).

3. How and why we use it (lawful basis)

  • Replying to enquiries and providing our services: contract, or steps before entering a contract.
  • Business-to-business marketing emails: legitimate interests (telling businesses about relevant services). You can opt out at any time, and we’ll stop.
  • Sending review requests on a client’s behalf: we act as a processor for our client, who is the controller of their customer data.
  • Accounts and tax records: legal obligation.

4. Who we share it with

Trusted service providers only, such as our website host (Netlify), email provider (Google) and payment provider [PAYMENT PROVIDER]. Some of these may process data outside the UK under appropriate safeguards (such as the UK International Data Transfer Addendum or adequacy regulations). We never sell your data.

5. How long we keep it

Enquiries: up to 24 months. Client records: 6 years after the end of our contract (for tax purposes). Opt-out requests: we keep a minimal record so we don’t contact you again. [CONFIRM PERIODS]

6. Your rights

You have the right to access, correct, delete or restrict your data, to object to processing (including marketing, at any time), and to data portability. To use these rights, email us. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ico.org.uk, 0303 123 1113).

7. Cookies and analytics

Google Analytics 4: We use Google Analytics, provided by Google Ireland Ltd, to understand how visitors use our site (for example, which pages are viewed, device and browser type, and approximate location). Analytics data is only collected with your consent. IP addresses are anonymised automatically by Google Analytics 4. Cookies used: _ga and _ga_* (session identifier and measurement ID). Data retention is set to 14 months in our Google Analytics configuration.

Your choice: When you first visit, we ask for your consent. You can accept or decline. If you accept, analytics cookies are set. If you decline, no analytics cookies are set. You can change your mind at any time using the Cookie settings link in the footer.

Other cookies: We use localStorage (browser storage) to remember your currency preference and whether you have dismissed the offer banner. These are strictly functional and do not track you.

Meta Pixel: We use Meta Pixel (Facebook Pixel), provided by Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd, to measure advertising effectiveness and build audiences for marketing campaigns. This service is only active with your consent. Cookies used: _fbp (browser identifier) and _fbc (click identifier, when relevant). Data collected includes pages viewed, actions taken, and browser information.

Third-party resources: Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which may receive your IP address as part of the request.

8. Changes

We may update this policy, and the latest version will always be on this page.
